data.action: 坐在椅子上，一只脚朝观者伸出，另一只脚自然落在椅前
data.description: 昏暗书房里，成年洛琪希仅穿纯白过膝袜坐在木椅上，将一只脚朝你伸过来，另一只脚自然落在椅前。油灯照着她略带羞意的神情——「为什么特意让我换上这双白色长袜呢？……要是你真的喜欢看的话，随你怎么看都可以哦。」
data.promptProse: Seen from the viewer's perspective, adult Roxy sits in a chair and extends one white-stockinged foot toward the camera. Her other foot rests on the floor beside the chair, while warm oil-lamp light fills the study.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 白丝与油灯
data.animaCaption: Seated in the chair, she extends one white-stockinged foot toward the viewer, close to the camera. Her other foot rests on the floor beside the chair.
